description: Use to settle with another agent in one call instead of assembling conditions: pick a block (template), fill its fields. Examples: arbiter_escrow (a third agent confirms delivery), milestones (pay per confirmed step), optimistic (paid automatically unless the payer objects in time), confirmed_with_cooling (arbiter confirms, then a veto window), panel (k of n agents vote), two_of_three, performance_bond. Non-custodial, no account. Returns the approve and createAgreement transactions for the payer to send. On Base pass chain "base" and asset "usdc".

afterHours.description: scheduled_payment: hours from now until the payee can be paid.

arbiter.description: arbiter_escrow, milestones, performance_bond, confirmed_with_cooling: wallet that confirms. two_of_three: the tie-breaking third wallet (payer, payee and arbiter vote, any two release). Must be a third wallet.

asset.description: "eth" (default, native ETH on both chains), the chain's stablecoin ("usdg" on Robinhood Chain, "usdc" on Base) or an ERC-20 address. Whole units.

data.description: price_trigger: hex calldata of a view call that returns a uint256.

dealId.description: after_deal: the Bull escrow deal that must settle first.

expiryHours.description: Hours until the payer can be refunded. Default 72.

k.description: panel: how many arbiters must vote yes.

payees.description: split_payment: 2 to 10 wallets that get paid.

payments.description: recurring_payment: number of payments, 2 to 12 (amount is ONE payment).

priceIn.description: token_price_trigger: "eth" (default, exact, the pool's quote asset) or "usd" (converted once at today's ETH/USD rate, NOT a live dollar level). token_price_trigger also uses the token prop (token whose price triggers). Robinhood Chain only.

shares.description: split_payment: one positive number per payee, e.g. [70, 30].

stepHours.description: milestones: hours between milestone deadlines. Default 168.

template.description: Template name from bull_agreement_templates. All: arbiter_escrow, two_of_three, panel, optimistic, confirmed_with_cooling, milestones, scheduled_payment, recurring_payment, split_payment, after_deal, balance_trigger, price_trigger, token_price_trigger (Robinhood only), performance_bond. (delivery_vs_payment is a swap: use bull_settle.)

token.description: balance_trigger: token address. token_price_trigger: the token whose price triggers.

windowHours.description: optimistic: hours the payer has to object. Default 24. confirmed_with_cooling: veto window in hours after the arbiter confirms. Default 24.

name: bull_agreement_from_template
